profile.summary: WTS Capital Berhad, an investment holding company, provides corporate solutions in Malaysia, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company provides digital transformation and automation solutions for artificial intelligence, enterprise resource planning, internet of things, and human capital management. The company offers enterprise digital solutions, system integration, software development, automation platforms, application development and integration, and artificial intelligence applications. It provides AI data center turnkey solutions, AI infrastructure and computing solutions, generative AI solutions including SysBot.AI, and computer vision and image recognition technologies. The company also offers low-power telematics devices and systems, real-time enterprise asset monitoring, IoT sensor deployment and implementation, data aggregation platforms, and smart agriculture and industrial automation solutions. It provides intelligent HR solutions, payroll systems, workforce management, talent acquisition, employee engagement tools, and AI-powered HR technologies. The company offers systems integration, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, business continuity solutions, IT consultancy, and managed technology services. The company also offers rental management software, smart home IoT solutions, connected property ecosystems, intelligent automation, and digital property technologies. Additionally, the company provides business process optimization services. WTS Capital Berhad was formerly known as Systech Bhd and changed its name to WTS Capital Berhad in September 2026. WTS Capital Berhad was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
profile.zh: WTS Capital Berhad 是一家投资控股公司，在马来西亚、亚洲其他地区及国际范围提供企业解决方案，前身为 Systech Bhd，于 2026 年 9 月更名，成立于 2010 年，总部位于马来西亚吉隆坡。
lines: 数字化转型与自动化：提供人工智能、企业资源规划、物联网和人力资本管理的数字化与自动化解决方案。
企业数字解决方案与系统集成：提供系统集成、软件开发、自动化平台、应用开发与集成及人工智能应用。
AI 基础设施与计算：提供 AI 数据中心交钥匙方案、AI 基础设施与计算方案、包括 SysBot.AI 的生成式 AI 方案以及计算机视觉与图像识别技术。
物联网与工业自动化：提供低功耗远程信息处理设备与系统、企业资产实时监控、IoT 传感器部署实施、数据聚合平台及智慧农业与工业自动化方案。
智能人力资源：提供智能 HR 方案、薪酬系统、劳动力管理、人才招聘、员工互动工具及 AI 驱动的人力资源技术。
IT 与托管技术服务：提供系统集成、网络安全、云基础设施、业务连续性方案、IT 咨询及托管技术服务。
